test_inputmap_clear_bindings: test the InputMap class clear_bindings method to reset all action and callback bindings
test_inputmap_bind_key: test the InputMap bind method to register a callback for a specific key like KEY_UP
test_inputmap_bind_exclusive: test the InputMap bind method with Exclusive wrapper to register an exclusive key callback
test_inputmap_bind_range: test the InputMap bind method with Range to map multiple key-modifier combos to indexed callbacks
test_inputmap_mouse_handlers: test the InputMap mouse move and scroll handlers to verify plane and z-axis callbacks fire correctly
